quote: I attended the People Management Training yesterday and found it incredibly useful. The session provided valuable insights into understanding not only my own management style but also how to approach managing staff more effectively. I learned a lot about leveraging individual skills and personality traits to build stronger, more cohesive teams. The training offered practical strategies that I can immediately implement to foster better communication and collaboration. I am looking forward to attending further sessions and building on what I have learned already. Highly recommended for anyone looking to improve their leadership skills!
author: Sarah Holdaway
subject: Personality at Work
